description: This PHP class, 'TemplateParent', extends 'TemplateEnum' and defines a dynamic field template for parent relationships in SuiteCRM. It provides methods to generate field definitions, handle deletion, saving, and database alterations related to a 'parent' type field, including associated 'parent_type' and 'parent_id' subfields.

classes.name: TemplateParent
classes.description: A PHP class extending TemplateEnum to define a 'parent' type dynamic field, including methods for field definition, deletion, saving, and database alteration handling.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Generates the field definition array with specific properties for the 'parent' field type, including type_name, id_name, parent_type, source, and studio visibility.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the 'parent_type' and 'parent_id' subfields associated with this template field.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the 'parent' field along with its associated 'parent_type' and 'parent_id' subfields, setting properties such as name, vname, label, length, and importable status.

methods.name: get_db_add_alter_table
methods.description: Returns an empty string, as database addition alterations are not needed for this field.

methods.name: get_db_modify_alter_table
methods.description: Returns an empty string, as database modification alterations are not needed for this field.
